subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

ERA : ETA :: HONEST : JOPEUV :: GRAIN : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• **Consonants** - (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Vowels** - Remains same.

So,

 
• ERA : ETA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d546fb47d01d628fe8b816341197497bebde47ec188858cc81cfc2a8209c2b17.png] 

​And,

 
• HONEST : JOPEUV

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a79bb7748706157309e9e326b8b5a85b113f3ee578ee520fc97ec04e87097e4e.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• GRAIN : 

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1c8390826931e9ae4cd5b58cdbf1ca25778c5bd75ce5a61c60a61c426929370.png] 

​Hence, **"ITAIP"** is the correct answer.
